claim.claim-text: 1. A composition comprising HCFO-1233xf and at least one additional compound selected from the group consisting of HCFO-1232xd, HCFC-253fb, ethylene, HFC-23, CFC-13, HFC-143a, HFC-152a, HFC-236fa, HCO-1130, HCO-1130a, HCFC-244db, HFC-245fa, HFC-245cb, HCFC-133a, HCFC-254fb, HCFC-1131, HCFO-1242zf, HCFC-226ba, and HFC-227ca.
2. The composition of claim 1, wherein the total amount of additional compound(s) in the composition ranges from greater than zero weight percent to about 99 weight percent.
3. The composition of claim 1, wherein the total amount of additional compounds ranges from greater than zero weight percent to about 80 weight percent.
4. The composition of claim 1, wherein the total amount of additional compound(s) ranges from greater than zero weight percent to about 50 weight percent.
5. The composition of claim 1, wherein the total amount of additional compound(s) ranges from greater than zero weight percent to about 30 weight percent.
6. The composition of claim 1, wherein the total amount of additional compound(s) ranges from greater than zero weight percent to about 10 weight percent.
7. The use of the composition of any of claims 1 to 6 in a process to make HFO-1234yf.
8. The use of the composition of any of claims 1 to 6 in a process to make HCFC-244bb.
9. Process to make HFO-1234yf using the composition of any of claims 1 to 6.
10. Process to make HCFC-244bb using the composition of any of claims 1 to 6.
11. The use of HCFC-244bb obtainable by the process of claim 10 to produce HFO-1234yf.
